add_library(mln-circle-layer STATIC shared/cpp/circle_layer.cpp)
target_compile_features(mln-circle-layer PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
set_target_properties(mln-circle-layer PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_include_directories(mln-circle-layer PUBLIC shared/include)
# shared/cpp/circle_shader_sources.hpp is generated by scripts/generate-shaders.ts and checked in.
# The parent supplies the plugin API headers through its SDK target.
